data.summary: When the selector says 'no test reaches the change' the ci plan is scope=full, but the run's pre-commit range has no changed file for the tests hook, so only gitleaks runs. Evidence still says scope full, the run still queued for the host suite slot, ci records passed, and testscope.py then passes unit_tests as covered with 'the ci gate ran the whole suite on this tree'. Log .ddflow/runs/RF-core-records-split/ci-*.log: ddflow-suite-wait 1301 s, then one hook, ci: passed, for an item that landed 6 files, +1395/-1257; unit_tests covered, changed_lines 2652. Same on DRV-orchestration (ci-20261103T235822367343Z-1990048.log), fix-B2fc7f7fbba, ADP-census. Count: 13 ci passes with scope=full, no pytest summary and under 180 s net of queue since 2026-10-29; 9 unit_tests 'covered' events on those items. Expected: scope full records what ran (no test hook ran is not a full run); covered needs a pytest summary; a run with no tests takes no suite slot.
data.title: ci scope 'full' passes with no pytest run, and unit_tests is then 'covered' by a whole-suite run that never happened

data.summary: Since 2026-10-25, of 33 gate.passed ci events 17 have no elapsed_s and 18 no preceding gate.started (ran_by 'ddflow ci run', command 'pre-commit run ...'); 40 of 102 failed full and 166 of 363 failed selected, and 219 of 307 partial, also carry neither. So `ddflow metrics` ci n=2447 p50 8m is computed over a subset that drops most hand-recorded and ran_by outcomes, and cannot be compared across outcomes. A later `ddflow ci run` record on the same tree also doubles the outcome (fix-B31c3fd06ee: passed at 08:37 with elapsed 33.4 s, again at 08:38 with none). Expected: an outcome recorded from a finished run carries that run's elapsed_s and waited_s, and metrics reports how many outcomes it could not time.
data.title: metrics gate time for ci is biased: a pass recorded by `ddflow ci run` has no gate.started and no elapsed_s
